identity.name: BR 05

case.bezel: integrated square with rounded bezel ring

identity.one_liner: The 2019 BR 05 — Bell & Ross's integrated-bracelet sport watch, the case that competes with the Royal Oak and the Nautilus at the sub-$5,000 price point.

narrative.story: The BR 05 (2019) is Bell & Ross's answer to the integrated-bracelet steel-sport category. The 40mm case softens the BR 03's hard square edges with a rounded bezel ring and an integrated bracelet — a design that reads as a cockpit panel refined for the wrist rather than a cockpit panel strapped to the wrist. The BR-CAL.321 (Sellita SW300-1 base) is the same movement family as the BR 03. The BR 05 is the most-cited modern Bell & Ross and the watch a collector cites when they want the integrated-bracelet design language at a price point below the Swiss trio.
narrative.collector_notes: The BR 05 was designed by Bruno Belamich (the "Bell" of Bell & Ross). The integrated bracelet distinguishes it from the BR 03's strap-only design.
